GTXMOD Mod Installer vendor note

Upstream project: https://github.com/pmachapman/unrar
Pinned upstream commit: cacdcb8cbe1813b6151e3f92f2ccec7afe4d6a41

This directory contains the upstream UnRAR source files used by the installer.
The build compiles the RARDLL interface into the PS4 application; it supports
RAR extraction only and does not create RAR archives. The upstream license is
included here as license.txt and is also shipped with the application at
assets/licenses/UnRAR-license.txt. The required license permission paragraph
is reproduced in installer/rar_extract.cpp.

The installer currently accepts only single-volume, unencrypted RAR archives.
It rejects unsafe member paths, symbolic links/redirections, split entries,
and archives exceeding the entry/file/total uncompressed-size limits in
installer/rar_extract.cpp.
